a.lede: Today, shared Microsoft 365 plans include 1 TB of OneDrive cloud storage for every family member. Microsoft is about to shrink that allotment dramatically.
a.title: Got a Microsoft 365 subscription? Your storage is about to shrink

b.lede: What Microsoft giveth, Microsoft taketh away, again and again
b.title: Microsoft 365 subscribers set to lose up to 4 TB of OneDrive storage
